methodology: Individual-sense review and model-assisted semantic curation of high-frequency Chinese, Japanese, Korean and Arabic forms. Exact native form and existing concept IDs are fixed before source-language joining. These preferences do not attest sense-frequency counts: corpus rows count surface tokens, while ordinary meanings were editorially selected. Exclusions affect frequency decks only and preserve valid dictionary senses. Corpus punctuation, truncated stems and inflected/contraction tokens are not forced onto unrelated standalone dictionary lemmas. Missing translations remain unavailable. No native-speaker certification is claimed.

reviewedScope.additionalReview: Candidate English headwords/gloss summaries were inspected across every matched top1000 form; additional exact sense decisions and high-risk inflection/homonym exclusions are recorded explicitly. This is not a claim of context-tagged corpus disambiguation or native-speaker certification.
